seed: Detached sound can be put back into its picture (task detached-sound-can-be-put-back-into-its-picture), at Next defaults with no flag touched. The sample recording's sound is taken off with a right-click on its segment, Detach Audio, and slid three frames off its picture with Command Right. A right-click on the loose sound now offers Re-attach Audio in the same place; choosing it takes the loose sound away and the picture plays its own sound again, back in step from 0:00. One Command Z puts the loose, slid sound back; Command Shift Z joins them again. The menu bar's Control Shift D row is walked by re-attach-audio-menu-bar-walk, which needs the probe in front.

steps.note: At defaults: the recording on V1 with its own sound linked under it on Audio

steps.comment: The sound segment on Audio, where a-clip-s-sound-is-linked-under-it-walk right-clicks it.

steps.note: Right-click, Detach Audio: the sound is its own clip on the same track, and it is the one picked
Command Right three times: the loose sound is three frames behind its picture
THE TEST: right-click on the loose sound, Re-attach Audio. The loose clip is gone and the picture's own sound is linked under it again on Audio, from 0:00, back in step
One Command Z brought back the loose, slid sound; Command Shift Z joined them again
